system.description:
You take a reverse grip with your weapon and prepare to cut down everyone in your way. Select a space within range. You dash through at blinding speeds to that select location. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. All creatures whom you pass through while on the way to the select location are the targets of your attacks. Make a single melee taijutsu attack, comparing the result against the AC of each creature you pass through while moving. On a hit, you deal your weapons damage die. You end your movement in the selected space.

Chain 1: If the next Bukijutsu you cast has the Chain keyword, reduce its cost by 2.

Chain 2: If the next Bukijutsu you cast forced any of the affected creatures to make a saving throw, they make their saving throw with a -2 penalty.
